purpose: claude s81-grpA r5 / dsfd_vm_be_sl r6: r5 dsfd_vm_be_sl-r5-21672a82e-g5 TT -69.37 / FF +3.40 (2,060 D pins; i2r +245, out +175 = recipe 2 worked) was a KIT HOOK-ORDER DEFECT, not RTL: kits generated after 6a3b8e235 source be_sl_str_boundary.tcl from their own post-CTS wrapper, so the ck/cks inter-clock insertion balance (r3/r4 mechanism) never ran: routed ck 271 / cks 153 ps, every core->str ratio-FIFO hop (u_rc*.mem->sh) lost 118 ps of its 208 ps 4:3 window.
